scope: Explicit default-Compatible converter adapter input policy, owned requested/applied policy handoff and conservative source-profile refusal. Not closed exact-source profile/CLI admission, installed-library API expansion or new producer/native support.

behavior.input: dx_iface::fileImport(file,data,debug,DRW::DxfCodePagePolicy) has a Compatible default. Request recorded in the DXF outcome before facade construction; setter applied before debug/read.
behavior.outcome: Appended requestedCodePagePolicy is separate from observations.codePagePolicy and readReturned/readThrew/operationSucceeded. Return/unwind/diagnostic-copy failures retain evidence; non-DXF attempts reset DXF-specific state.
behavior.lifecycle: Per-import outcome reset preserves existing append-to-model behavior. Copied request/applied values survive later caller policy mutation/default import.
behavior.admission: Unknown requested policy or request/applied disagreement is EvidenceUnavailable. Existing issues remain ObservedIssues. Pending closed per-consumption profile review, simultaneous exactNamedDecodeCalls and nonAsciiDecodeCalls under ExactNamed cause UnsupportedProfile, regardless of a later canonical HEADER or zero issue mask.
behavior.guardLimit: Counters overlap across fields; this is conservative refusal only, not exact family identification/producer qualification. Decoder-independent ASCII/represented escapes and modern inert metadata retain existing eligibility. Some mixed-profile harmless cases can conservatively refuse until3.3c.2b replaces the guard.
behavior.export: Caller-explicit Compatible source admission can export exact-decoded data under the independent RequireLossless target guard. Actual two-pass outputs preserve literal text/LINE and reimport with default Compatible; this does not qualify input producer grammar.
behavior.defaults: No CLI option or default changes. Existing three-argument source calls compile; the internal adapter signature is not a member-pointer/binary-ABI promise. Installed library sources/API/callbacks are unchanged by this slice.

tests.coreMatrix: Two ISO spellings × legacy/modern × ASCII/binary input. Each performs two exports plus third read, with opposite legacy/modern target and matching ASCII/binary output framing.
semanticAssertions: no decoder issues for actual exact mapping
original owned outcome unchanged by exports
lifecycleControls: early missing-file return with zero events
late invalid-handle return with completed exact prefix
next defaulted import resets policies/events without changing copied result
invalid-extension reset without invented DXF request
unavailable-family high-byte issues versus decoder-independent ASCII CIF
later canonical HEADER cannot qualify earlier exact high bytes
tests.callbackScope: Caller argument mutation during text callback; returned success, original nonallocating callback sentinel unwind, diagnostic-copy allocation failure. All corrected same-adapter retries use fresh default policy.

asanUbsan.scope: Rebuilt changed adapter/test TUs and fresh focused mode; core instrumented archive remains identical to preceding reader acceptance.

limits: Before-facade request recording is source-reviewed; constructor/setup allocation failure was not newly fault-injected.
Returned read and callback/diagnostic-copy exceptions are executed; this does not promise whole-model rollback or concurrency safety.

Existing140 codec defaults are not rerun because all core sources and regular/instrumented archives are identical to prior bound acceptance; new adapter defaults are checked by actual codec/CLI tests.
No issue mask or count is treated as a charset/producer/whole-drawing certificate.

next.action: Record closed cumulative consumed mapping-profile identity and review explicit compatibility eligibility before broader CLI opt-in. Replace the conservative guard only with tested per-consumption rules; retain native/producer/support gates independently.

fixturePolicy: Only scratch runtime-authored DXF inputs; no downloaded drawings, committed fixtures, new dependency or CTest registration. Existing user-owned untracked files preserved.
documentation: README.md internal adapter requested/applied policy and conservative admission
both implementation plans updated with actual scope/results/next gate
